_about: What keeps you coming back (round 30, Robert 2026-10-03: 'we don't want a boring game we want it to keep people coming back'). Engine: Game.gd 'retention' -- the daily trial (TrialGen.gd), the week's sect trials, the Trial Board's marks, collections, rare world events, and ascension. Missing a day never takes anything away.

blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.desc: Elites everywhere, and they carry more.

glass_edge.name: Glass Edge
glass_edge.desc: Every blow lands half again as hard -- yours and theirs.

swarming.name: Swarming Halls
swarming.desc: Half as many again of them, a little weaker each.

quickened.name: Quickened
quickened.desc: They move faster than they should.

spirit_tide.name: Spirit Tide
spirit_tide.desc: The air is thick with qi: twice what you'd gather.

no_mercy.name: No Mercy
no_mercy.desc: Your wounds don't close on their own in here.

veteran.name: Veterans
veteran.desc: Every one of them has a fighting style -- no plain brawlers.

shop.name: A night with the trial-keeper's notes (+4 insight)
A drop of ancestral blood (once your blood has woken)

blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.desc: The light down here has gone red. There are more of them, and worse.

spirit_tide.name: Spirit Tide
spirit_tide.desc: Qi rolls through these halls like a spring flood: everything you gather here, doubled.

wandering_master.name: A Wandering Master
wandering_master.desc: Someone has set up a little camp on this floor -- an old cultivator, passing through.

meteor_fall.name: Meteor Fall
meteor_fall.desc: Something fell through the rock and is still glowing. Star iron, if you're quick.

treasure_spirit.name: Treasure Spirit
treasure_spirit.desc: A little gilded thing is running around this floor, dropping coins. It won't stay long.

heavenly_sign.name: Heavenly Sign
heavenly_sign.desc: The stars show through the rock for a moment. Old blood answers.

start_gold.name: Remembered Wealth
start_gold.desc: +150 gold at the start of each climb

true_blood.name: True Blood
true_blood.desc: Keep 10% more of your bloodline's purity when you ascend

heirloom.name: Heirloom
heirloom.desc: Carry one more piece of gear into the next climb
